sources.title: South Sudan: entry visa regime
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Czech Republic
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Czech MFA Consular Department traveller database expressly requires a pre-travel tourist eVisa for Czech citizens and says the issued visa must be printed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: O eVisa se žádá online na oficiálních stránkách evisa.gov.ss.

policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: Djibouti electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Czech MFA guidance requires Czech tourists to obtain Djibouti's eVisa online before travel and says airport visa applications are unavailable.
conditions: Apply before travel through Djibouti's official eVisa service; the stated tourist eVisa is single entry and valid up to 90 days.
Czech MFA says visa applications on arrival have not been available since 2019. Work, study, residence, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.
Recheck before travel because the live Czech MFA entry record does not display a substantive update date.

application.label: Djibouti official eVisa
application.processingTime: Czech MFA reports processing can take up to two weeks.
steps: Submit the tourist application through the official eVisa service before travel.
Print the issued visa and keep it with the passport for entry.

policies.title: Czech ordinary passports: South Sudan electronic tourist visa
policies.summary: Czech MFA guidance requires Czech tourists to obtain South Sudan's eVisa online before travel and present the printed issued visa at entry.
conditions: Apply before travel through South Sudan's official eVisa service; Czech MFA says the issued visa must be printed and carried in the passport.

Czech MFA says airport visa applications are unavailable. The alternative embassy route, registration after arrival, work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier controls and final admission remain separate.
Recheck before travel because the live Czech MFA entry record does not display a substantive update date.

application.label: South Sudan official eVisa
application.processingTime: Czech MFA reports processing of two to three days.
steps: Submit the tourist eVisa application through the official service before travel.
Print the issued visa and present it with the passport at entry.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback labels Djibouti visa on arrival, but Czech MFA requires a tourist eVisa before travel and says airport visa applications are unavailable.
